the IFNL3/IFNL4 risk allele, which does not produce IFNL4 but produces IFNL3, is associated with more severe liver inflammation and fibrosis, but the IFNL3 protein rather than the IFNL4 protein mediates the association.

the genetic variation in the IFN- λ3/λ4 region is not a driver of liver fibrosis.
